sourceReview.adjudication: The deliberate undersized disassembly buffer exercises WZ_RESULT_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL and bounded termination. The first paging run exposed an incorrect test expectation after selecting bank 0 while asserting bank 2; the fixture now locks bank 2 and verifies it remains selected. The reported unsigned subtraction underflow is prevented by the preceding pattern_length > length return; length is bounded to the 16-bit address space. For mapped memory copies, the full source range is snapshotted to preserve overlap semantics across physical bank aliases; allocation failure is returned before mutation, while ordinary linear 48K copies retain memmove. The reported profile null dereference cannot occur because writable_range rejects a missing profile before entering the branch, and mapped memory helpers also handle a null profile.
